records.title: Discipline, consistency, and controlled strength
records.publicText: Mark believes consistency is more dependable than temporary intensity. He values doing the work even when motivation is absent and wants actions to prove intentions rather than relying only on words. He sees discomfort as a necessary part of growth and believes progress comes from repeated controlled effort. He wants to become better at controlling his actions, emotions, and responses. He is drawn to strength with direction and believes strength without discipline can become wasted potential. He values control, patience, structure, and deliberate action, and prefers confidence that is earned and controlled rather than loud or arrogant. He focuses on what he can control, values accountability for his work and responses, and wants confidence to come from preparation and demonstrated work.
records.shortText: Consistency over temporary intensity; controlled effort, earned confidence, accountability, and strength with direction.

records.title: Growth, values, and public personality framing
records.publicText: Mark sees setbacks as lessons that can improve future decisions. He wants to become steadily better through consistent work, does not view himself as finished, and expects his goals to evolve. He values rebuilding, learning, and continuing after difficult periods, and wants to avoid becoming so comfortable that he stops progressing. Approved public values include discipline, consistency, responsibility, ownership, ambition, resilience, patience, humility, learning, family support, financial independence, usefulness, creativity, personal growth, controlled confidence, and direct communication. Safe public personality framing includes ambitious, reflective, disciplined, growth-oriented, creative, detail-focused, willing to rebuild, comfortable spending time alone, motivated by meaningful progress, direct and practical, confident when prepared, interested in multiple perspectives, and serious about improving technically and personally. These are public-facing themes, not medical or psychological assessments.

records.title: Bodybuilding meaning and training lessons
records.publicText: Bodybuilding is Mark’s strongest personal passion outside technology. He views bodybuilding as an art built through symmetry, structure, patience, detail, and repetition. Training has taught him discipline, consistency, patience, self-awareness, and what his body and mindset can handle in a public-safe sense. His current fitness focus is aesthetics, controlled movement, quality repetitions, and deliberate progress rather than only maximum strength. He believes lessons from training can apply to projects, routines, and professional development, and fitness is part of the identity and environment he is working to build. Do not include physical measurements, medical history, drugs, supplements, or private body-image statements.

records.title: Greek mythology figure connections
records.publicText: Mark is interested in Achilles, Icarus, Heracles, Greek statues, and classical art. He is drawn to stories involving ambition, discipline, strength, sacrifice, consequence, resilience, limitation, and transformation. Mark does not need one permanent favorite figure; different figures may represent different parts of his current mindset and future growth. A safe concise framing is that Mark connects with different figures for different reasons: Icarus for ambition, Achilles for intensity, and Heracles for discipline and endurance. Icarus connects to ambition, dreaming, risk, and the consequences of losing control. Achilles connects to intensity, strength, pride, drive, and human vulnerability. Heracles connects to endurance, discipline, repeated trials, and becoming stronger through difficult work. Mythology is a creative and symbolic interest, not Mark’s religion.
records.shortText: Icarus for ambition, Achilles for intensity, and Heracles for discipline and endurance; no permanent single favorite.

records.title: Career purpose, success, and family support
records.publicText: Mark’s immediate goal is to secure a stable role in technology. He is open to software development, full-stack work, developer tools, data-oriented systems, technical support, and other suitable entry-level technology roles. He wants a role that creates stability and provides a path for continued growth. He wants to become financially independent and support his family. He wants his career to prove to himself that he can create something meaningful. He is open to Milwaukee, Chicago, remote work, and other locations when the opportunity and compensation make relocation practical. Long-term success means stability, confidence, meaningful work, independence, continued ambition, and excitement about what comes next. He wants work that makes him proud because he built something useful and followed through. Money is not his only motivation.
records.shortText: Stable technology role with growth, independence, meaningful work, and family support; open to Milwaukee, Chicago, remote, or practical relocation.

records.title: Photography, travel meaning, and hobbies
records.publicText: Mark uses photography to preserve feelings, places, views, memories, and important moments. He likes photographing cities, architecture, streets, water, mountains, museums, landscapes, friends, and travel experiences. He prefers cinematic, personal, real, dark, low-exposure, and story-driven images. Cities represent ambition and the feeling of having made progress. Oceans and islands represent peace. Mountains and hikes represent effort that earns the view. Travel helps him see different cultures, lifestyles, opportunities, and perspectives, and motivates him to work toward a life with greater independence and freedom. Approved public hobbies include bodybuilding, gym training, hiking, reading, music, travel, photography, running, Greek mythology, classical statues and art, museums, and exploring cities and landscapes.
